self.index_to_id.get(&index).map(|s| s.as_str())\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of entries\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    fn len(&self) -> usize {\n        self.id_to_index.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if empty\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.id_to_index.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Save to file\n    fn save(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n        let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to serialize ID map: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n        fs::write(path, content)\n            .map_err(|e| AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to write ID map: {}\", e)))?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Load from file\n    fn load(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {\n        let content = fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .map_err(|e| AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to read ID map: {}\", e)))?;\n        serde_json::from_str(&content)\n            .map_err(|e| AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to parse ID map: {}\", e)))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Vector index for semantic search\n///\n/// Wraps turbovec's TurboQuantIndex with session-level and chunk-level indexes.\n/// All embeddings are quantized using TurboQuant at the configured bit width.\npub struct VectorIndex {\n    /// Session-level index (one embedding per session)\n    sessions_index: Option<TurboQuantIndex>,\n    /// Session ID to index mapping\n    sessions_id_map: IdMap,\n    /// Chunk-level index (multiple embeddings per session)\n    chunks_index: Option<TurboQuantIndex>,\n    /// Chunk ID to index mapping\n    chunks_id_map: IdMap,\n    /// Directory containing the index files\n    data_dir: PathBuf,\n    /// Configuration for the vector index\n    config: VectorConfig,\n    /// Embedding dimension (determined by the model used)\n    embedding_dim: usize,\n}\n\nimpl VectorIndex {\n    /// Create a new vector index\n    ///\n    /// This creates new indexes in memory. Call `load_or_create()` to load\n    /// existing indexes from disk or create new ones.\n    pub fn new(data_dir: PathBuf, config: VectorConfig, embedding_dim: usize) -> Self {\n        VectorIndex {\n            sessions_index: None,\n            sessions_id_map: IdMap::default(),\n            chunks_index: None,\n            chunks_id_map: IdMap::default(),\n            data_dir,\n            config,\n            embedding_dim,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load existing indexes from disk, or create new ones if they don't exist\n    ///\n    /// This is the primary entry point for working with the vector index.\n    /// It will:\n    /// - Load existing indexes if they exist\n    /// - Create new indexes if they don't\n    /// - Return an error if the index file exists but is corrupted\n    pub fn load_or_create(\n        data_dir: PathBuf,\n        config: VectorConfig,\n        embedding_dim: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Self> {\n        let index_dir = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n\n        // Ensure index directory exists\n        fs::create_dir_all(&index_dir).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to create vector index directory: {}: {}\",\n                index_dir.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        let sessions_path = index_dir.join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE);\n        let sessions_map_path = index_dir.join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        let _chunks_path = index_dir.join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE); // Temporarily unused\n        let chunks_map_path = index_dir.join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n\n        // Load or create session index\n        let (sessions_index, sessions_id_map) = if sessions_path.exists() {\n            // Load existing index\n            let id_map = if sessions_map_path.exists() {\n                IdMap::load(&sessions_map_path)?\n            } else {\n                IdMap::default()\n            };\n            let index = Self::load_index_from_disk(&sessions_path, embedding_dim)?;\n            (Some(index), id_map)\n        } else {\n            // Create new index\n            let id_map = IdMap::default();\n            let index = Self::create_index(embedding_dim, config.bit_width)?;\n            (Some(index), id_map)\n        };\n\n        // Load or create chunk index\n        let (chunks_index, chunks_id_map) = if config.index_chunks {\n            if _chunks_path.exists() {\n                let id_map = if chunks_map_path.exists() {\n                    IdMap::load(&chunks_map_path)?\n                } else {\n                    IdMap::default()\n                };\n                let index = Self::load_index_from_disk(&_chunks_path, embedding_dim)?;\n                (Some(index), id_map)\n            } else {\n                let id_map = IdMap::default();\n                let index = Self::create_index(embedding_dim, config.bit_width)?;\n                (Some(index), id_map)\n            }\n        } else {\n            (None, IdMap::default())\n        };\n\n        Ok(VectorIndex {\n            sessions_index,\n            sessions_id_map,\n            chunks_index,\n            chunks_id_map,\n            data_dir,\n            config,\n            embedding_dim,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new TurboQuantIndex with the given dimension and bit width\n    fn create_index(dim: usize, bit_width: u8) -> Result<TurboQuantIndex> {\n        // Validate bit width (turbovec supports 2, 3, or 4 bits)\n        if bit_width != 2 && bit_width != 3 && bit_width != 4 {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Invalid bit width: {}. Must be 2, 3, or 4\",\n                bit_width\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Validate dimension (must be multiple of 8)\n        if !dim.is_multiple_of(8) {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Invalid dimension: {}. Must be a multiple of 8\",\n                dim\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Create the TurboQuantIndex with the specified parameters\n        TurboQuantIndex::new(dim, bit_width as usize).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to create TurboQuantIndex: {}\", e))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Load an index from disk\n    fn load_index_from_disk(path: &Path, _dim: usize) -> Result<TurboQuantIndex> {\n        TurboQuantIndex::load(path).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to load TurboQuantIndex from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Save indexes to disk\n    ///\n    /// Persists both the session and chunk indexes to their respective files.\n    /// This should be called after bulk updates (e.g., after embedding multiple sessions).\n    pub fn save(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let index_dir = self.data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n\n        // Ensure index directory exists\n        fs::create_dir_all(&index_dir).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to create vector index directory: {}: {}\",\n                index_dir.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        // Save session index and ID map\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.sessions_index {\n            let sessions_path = index_dir.join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE);\n            index.write(&sessions_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to save session index: {}\", e))\n            })?;\n        }\n\n        let sessions_map_path = index_dir.join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        fs::create_dir_all(index_dir.join(\"sessions_\")).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to create sessions map directory: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n        self.sessions_id_map.save(&sessions_map_path)?;\n\n        // Save chunk index and ID map if chunks enabled\n        if self.config.index_chunks {\n            if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n                let chunks_path = index_dir.join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE);\n                index.write(&chunks_path).map_err(|e| {\n                    AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to save chunk index: {}\", e))\n                })?;\n            }\n\n            let chunks_map_path = index_dir.join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n            fs::create_dir_all(index_dir.join(\"chunks_\")).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to create chunks map directory: {}\",\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n            self.chunks_id_map.save(&chunks_map_path)?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Upsert a session-level embedding\n    ///\n    /// Inserts or updates the embedding for a session.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `id` - Session ID string (e.g., \"claude-code/83f5a4e7\")\n    /// * `embedding` - Embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    pub fn upsert_session(&mut self, id: &str, embedding: Vec<f32>) -> Result<()> {\n        if embedding.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                embedding.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref mut index) = self.sessions_index {\n            // Get the next index (or existing index if already inserted)\n            let vec_index = if let Some(idx_ref) = self.sessions_id_map.get(id) {\n                *idx_ref\n            } else {\n                let idx = self.sessions_id_map.len();\n                self.sessions_id_map.insert(id.to_string(), idx);\n                idx\n            };\n\n            // Add or update the embedding\n            index.add(&embedding);\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Upsert a chunk-level embedding\n    ///\n    /// Inserts or updates the embedding for a conversation chunk.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `id` - Chunk ID string (e.g., \"claude-code/83f5a4e7#3\")\n    /// * `embedding` - Embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    pub fn upsert_chunk(&mut self, id: &str, embedding: Vec<f32>) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.config.index_chunks {\n            return Ok(()); // Skip if chunk indexing is disabled\n        }\n\n        if embedding.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                embedding.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref mut index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Get the next index (or existing index if already inserted)\n            let vec_index = if let Some(&idx) = self.chunks_id_map.get(id) {\n                idx\n            } else {\n                let idx = self.chunks_id_map.len();\n                self.chunks_id_map.insert(id.to_string(), idx);\n                idx\n            };\n\n            // Add or update the embedding\n            index.add(&embedding);\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Search the session-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar sessions by cosine similarity.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `query_vec` - Query embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    /// * `k` - Number of results to return\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// A vector of (id_hash, similarity_score) tuples, sorted by similarity descending\n    pub fn search_sessions(&self, query_vec: &[f32], k: usize) -> Result<Vec<(String, f32)>> {\n        if query_vec.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.sessions_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // Convert indices back to IDs using the scores and indices fields\n            let converted: Vec<(String, f32)> = results\n                .indices\n                .iter()\n                .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.sessions_id_map.index_to_id.get(&(*idx as usize)).cloned().map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Search the chunk-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar chunks by cosine similarity.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `query_vec` - Query embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    /// * `k` - Number of results to return\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// A vector of (chunk_id, similarity_score) tuples, sorted by similarity descending\n    pub fn search_chunks(&self, query_vec: &[f32], k: usize) -> Result<Vec<(String, f32)>> {\n        if !self.config.index_chunks {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip if chunk indexing is disabled\n        }\n\n        if query_vec.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // Convert indices back to IDs using the scores and indices fields\n            let converted: Vec<(String, f32)> = results\n                .indices\n                .iter()\n                .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.chunks_id_map.index_to_id.get(&(*idx as usize)).cloned().map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of sessions in the index\n    pub fn session_count(&self) -> usize {\n        // Vector index temporarily disabled - return count from ID map\n        self.sessions_id_map.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of chunks in the index\n    pub fn chunk_count(&self) -> usize {\n        // Vector index temporarily disabled - return count from ID map\n        self.chunks_id_map.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if the index is empty\n    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.session_count() == 0 && self.chunk_count() == 0\n    }\n\n    /// Get the embedding dimension\n    pub fn dimension(&self) -> usize {\n        self.embedding_dim\n    }\n\n    /// Get the bit width\n    pub fn bit_width(&self) -> u8 {\n        self.config.bit_width\n    }\n\n    /// Get the index directory path\n    pub fn index_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\")\n    }\n\n    /// Get the sessions index file path\n    pub fn sessions_index_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.index_dir().join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the chunks index file path\n    pub fn chunks_index_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.index_dir().join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE)\n    }\n\n    /// Check if session index exists on disk\n    pub fn sessions_index_exists(&self) -> bool {\n        self.sessions_index_path().exists()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if chunk index exists on disk\n    pub fn chunks_index_exists(&self) -> bool {\n        self.chunks_index_path().exists()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if the vector index is actually functional (not stub mode)\n    ///\n    /// This is a runtime check to determine if real turbovec functionality is available.\n    /// Returns true if the sessions_index is Some (turbovec is enabled and working).\n    pub fn is_functional(&self) -> bool {\n        self.sessions_index.is_some()\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the session index from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for rebuilding the index from scratch.\n    pub fn delete_sessions_index(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.sessions_index_path();\n        if path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete session index: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        let map_path = self.index_dir().join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        if map_path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&map_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete sessions ID map: {}: {}\",\n                    map_path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the chunk index from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for rebuilding the index from scratch.\n    pub fn delete_chunks_index(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.chunks_index_path();\n        if path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete chunk index: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        let map_path = self.index_dir().join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        if map_path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&map_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete chunks ID map: {}: {}\",\n                    map_path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete both indexes from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for a complete rebuild of the vector index.\n    pub fn delete_all_indexes(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.delete_sessions_index()?;\n        self.delete_chunks_index()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build session text for embedding from events\n///\n/// Concatenates events with role prefixes to create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn Result<Self> {\n        let content = fs::read_to_string(path)\n            .map_err(|e| AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to read ID map: {}\", e)))?;\n        serde_json::from_str(&content)\n            .map_err(|e| AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to parse ID map: {}\", e)))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Vector index for semantic search\n///\n/// Wraps turbovec's TurboQuantIndex with session-level and chunk-level indexes.\n/// All embeddings are quantized using TurboQuant at the configured bit width.\npub struct VectorIndex {\n    /// Session-level index (one embedding per session)\n    sessions_index: Option<TurboQuantIndex>,\n    /// Session ID to index mapping\n    sessions_id_map: IdMap,\n    /// Chunk-level index (multiple embeddings per session)\n    chunks_index: Option<TurboQuantIndex>,\n    /// Chunk ID to index mapping\n    chunks_id_map: IdMap,\n    /// Directory containing the index files\n    data_dir: PathBuf,\n    /// Configuration for the vector index\n    config: VectorConfig,\n    /// Embedding dimension (determined by the model used)\n    embedding_dim: usize,\n}\n\nimpl VectorIndex {\n    /// Create a new vector index\n    ///\n    /// This creates new indexes in memory. Call `load_or_create()` to load\n    /// existing indexes from disk or create new ones.\n    pub fn new(data_dir: PathBuf, config: VectorConfig, embedding_dim: usize) -> Self {\n        VectorIndex {\n            sessions_index: None,\n            sessions_id_map: IdMap::default(),\n            chunks_index: None,\n            chunks_id_map: IdMap::default(),\n            data_dir,\n            config,\n            embedding_dim,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load existing indexes from disk, or create new ones if they don't exist\n    ///\n    /// This is the primary entry point for working with the vector index.\n    /// It will:\n    /// - Load existing indexes if they exist\n    /// - Create new indexes if they don't\n    /// - Return an error if the index file exists but is corrupted\n    pub fn load_or_create(\n        data_dir: PathBuf,\n        config: VectorConfig,\n        embedding_dim: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Self> {\n        let index_dir = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n\n        // Ensure index directory exists\n        fs::create_dir_all(&index_dir).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to create vector index directory: {}: {}\",\n                index_dir.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        let sessions_path = index_dir.join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE);\n        let sessions_map_path = index_dir.join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        let _chunks_path = index_dir.join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE); // Temporarily unused\n        let chunks_map_path = index_dir.join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n\n        // Load or create session index\n        let (sessions_index, sessions_id_map) = if sessions_path.exists() {\n            // Load existing index\n            let id_map = if sessions_map_path.exists() {\n                IdMap::load(&sessions_map_path)?\n            } else {\n                IdMap::default()\n            };\n            let index = Self::load_index_from_disk(&sessions_path, embedding_dim)?;\n            (Some(index), id_map)\n        } else {\n            // Create new index\n            let id_map = IdMap::default();\n            let index = Self::create_index(embedding_dim, config.bit_width)?;\n            (Some(index), id_map)\n        };\n\n        // Load or create chunk index\n        let (chunks_index, chunks_id_map) = if config.index_chunks {\n            if _chunks_path.exists() {\n                let id_map = if chunks_map_path.exists() {\n                    IdMap::load(&chunks_map_path)?\n                } else {\n                    IdMap::default()\n                };\n                let index = Self::load_index_from_disk(&_chunks_path, embedding_dim)?;\n                (Some(index), id_map)\n            } else {\n                let id_map = IdMap::default();\n                let index = Self::create_index(embedding_dim, config.bit_width)?;\n                (Some(index), id_map)\n            }\n        } else {\n            (None, IdMap::default())\n        };\n\n        Ok(VectorIndex {\n            sessions_index,\n            sessions_id_map,\n            chunks_index,\n            chunks_id_map,\n            data_dir,\n            config,\n            embedding_dim,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new TurboQuantIndex with the given dimension and bit width\n    fn create_index(dim: usize, bit_width: u8) -> Result<TurboQuantIndex> {\n        // Validate bit width (turbovec supports 2, 3, or 4 bits)\n        if bit_width != 2 && bit_width != 3 && bit_width != 4 {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Invalid bit width: {}. Must be 2, 3, or 4\",\n                bit_width\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Validate dimension (must be multiple of 8)\n        if !dim.is_multiple_of(8) {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Invalid dimension: {}. Must be a multiple of 8\",\n                dim\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Create the TurboQuantIndex with the specified parameters\n        TurboQuantIndex::new(dim, bit_width as usize).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to create TurboQuantIndex: {}\", e))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Load an index from disk\n    fn load_index_from_disk(path: &Path, _dim: usize) -> Result<TurboQuantIndex> {\n        TurboQuantIndex::load(path).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to load TurboQuantIndex from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Save indexes to disk\n    ///\n    /// Persists both the session and chunk indexes to their respective files.\n    /// This should be called after bulk updates (e.g., after embedding multiple sessions).\n    pub fn save(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let index_dir = self.data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n\n        // Ensure index directory exists\n        fs::create_dir_all(&index_dir).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to create vector index directory: {}: {}\",\n                index_dir.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        // Save session index and ID map\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.sessions_index {\n            let sessions_path = index_dir.join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE);\n            index.write(&sessions_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to save session index: {}\", e))\n            })?;\n        }\n\n        let sessions_map_path = index_dir.join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        fs::create_dir_all(index_dir.join(\"sessions_\")).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to create sessions map directory: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n        self.sessions_id_map.save(&sessions_map_path)?;\n\n        // Save chunk index and ID map if chunks enabled\n        if self.config.index_chunks {\n            if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n                let chunks_path = index_dir.join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE);\n                index.write(&chunks_path).map_err(|e| {\n                    AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to save chunk index: {}\", e))\n                })?;\n            }\n\n            let chunks_map_path = index_dir.join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n            fs::create_dir_all(index_dir.join(\"chunks_\")).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to create chunks map directory: {}\",\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n            self.chunks_id_map.save(&chunks_map_path)?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Upsert a session-level embedding\n    ///\n    /// Inserts or updates the embedding for a session.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `id` - Session ID string (e.g., \"claude-code/83f5a4e7\")\n    /// * `embedding` - Embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    pub fn upsert_session(&mut self, id: &str, embedding: Vec<f32>) -> Result<()> {\n        if embedding.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                embedding.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref mut index) = self.sessions_index {\n            // Get the next index (or existing index if already inserted)\n            let vec_index = if let Some(idx_ref) = self.sessions_id_map.get(id) {\n                *idx_ref\n            } else {\n                let idx = self.sessions_id_map.len();\n                self.sessions_id_map.insert(id.to_string(), idx);\n                idx\n            };\n\n            // Add or update the embedding\n            index.add(&embedding);\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Upsert a chunk-level embedding\n    ///\n    /// Inserts or updates the embedding for a conversation chunk.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `id` - Chunk ID string (e.g., \"claude-code/83f5a4e7#3\")\n    /// * `embedding` - Embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    pub fn upsert_chunk(&mut self, id: &str, embedding: Vec<f32>) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.config.index_chunks {\n            return Ok(()); // Skip if chunk indexing is disabled\n        }\n\n        if embedding.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                embedding.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref mut index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Get the next index (or existing index if already inserted)\n            let vec_index = if let Some(&idx) = self.chunks_id_map.get(id) {\n                idx\n            } else {\n                let idx = self.chunks_id_map.len();\n                self.chunks_id_map.insert(id.to_string(), idx);\n                idx\n            };\n\n            // Add or update the embedding\n            index.add(&embedding);\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Search the session-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar sessions by cosine similarity.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `query_vec` - Query embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    /// * `k` - Number of results to return\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// A vector of (id_hash, similarity_score) tuples, sorted by similarity descending\n    pub fn search_sessions(&self, query_vec: &[f32], k: usize) -> Result<Vec<(String, f32)>> {\n        if query_vec.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.sessions_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // Convert indices back to IDs using the scores and indices fields\n            let converted: Vec<(String, f32)> = results\n                .indices\n                .iter()\n                .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.sessions_id_map.index_to_id.get(&(*idx as usize)).cloned().map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Search the chunk-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar chunks by cosine similarity.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `query_vec` - Query embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    /// * `k` - Number of results to return\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// A vector of (chunk_id, similarity_score) tuples, sorted by similarity descending\n    pub fn search_chunks(&self, query_vec: &[f32], k: usize) -> Result<Vec<(String, f32)>> {\n        if !self.config.index_chunks {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip if chunk indexing is disabled\n        }\n\n        if query_vec.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // Convert indices back to IDs using the scores and indices fields\n            let converted: Vec<(String, f32)> = results\n                .indices\n                .iter()\n                .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.chunks_id_map.index_to_id.get(&(*idx as usize)).cloned().map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of sessions in the index\n    pub fn session_count(&self) -> usize {\n        // Vector index temporarily disabled - return count from ID map\n        self.sessions_id_map.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of chunks in the index\n    pub fn chunk_count(&self) -> usize {\n        // Vector index temporarily disabled - return count from ID map\n        self.chunks_id_map.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if the index is empty\n    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.session_count() == 0 && self.chunk_count() == 0\n    }\n\n    /// Get the embedding dimension\n    pub fn dimension(&self) -> usize {\n        self.embedding_dim\n    }\n\n    /// Get the bit width\n    pub fn bit_width(&self) -> u8 {\n        self.config.bit_width\n    }\n\n    /// Get the index directory path\n    pub fn index_dir(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\")\n    }\n\n    /// Get the sessions index file path\n    pub fn sessions_index_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.index_dir().join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE)\n    }\n\n    /// Get the chunks index file path\n    pub fn chunks_index_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n        self.index_dir().join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE)\n    }\n\n    /// Check if session index exists on disk\n    pub fn sessions_index_exists(&self) -> bool {\n        self.sessions_index_path().exists()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if chunk index exists on disk\n    pub fn chunks_index_exists(&self) -> bool {\n        self.chunks_index_path().exists()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if the vector index is actually functional (not stub mode)\n    ///\n    /// This is a runtime check to determine if real turbovec functionality is available.\n    /// Returns true if the sessions_index is Some (turbovec is enabled and working).\n    pub fn is_functional(&self) -> bool {\n        self.sessions_index.is_some()\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the session index from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for rebuilding the index from scratch.\n    pub fn delete_sessions_index(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.sessions_index_path();\n        if path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete session index: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        let map_path = self.index_dir().join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        if map_path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&map_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete sessions ID map: {}: {}\",\n                    map_path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the chunk index from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for rebuilding the index from scratch.\n    pub fn delete_chunks_index(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.chunks_index_path();\n        if path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete chunk index: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        let map_path = self.index_dir().join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        if map_path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&map_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete chunks ID map: {}: {}\",\n                    map_path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete both indexes from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for a complete rebuild of the vector index.\n    pub fn delete_all_indexes(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.delete_sessions_index()?;\n        self.delete_chunks_index()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build session text for embedding from events\n///\n/// Concatenates events with role prefixes to create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn vector index\n    ///\n    /// This creates new indexes in memory. Call `load_or_create()` to load\n    /// existing indexes from disk or create new ones.\n    pub fn new(data_dir: PathBuf, config: VectorConfig, embedding_dim: usize) -> Self {\n        VectorIndex {\n            sessions_index: None,\n            sessions_id_map: IdMap::default(),\n            chunks_index: None,\n            chunks_id_map: IdMap::default(),\n            data_dir,\n            config,\n            embedding_dim,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Load existing indexes from disk, or create new ones if they don't exist\n    ///\n    /// This is the primary entry point for working with the vector index.\n    /// It will:\n    /// - Load existing indexes if they exist\n    /// - Create new indexes if they don't\n    /// - Return an error if the index file exists but is corrupted\n    pub fn load_or_create(\n        data_dir: PathBuf,\n        config: VectorConfig,\n        embedding_dim: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Self> {\n        let index_dir = data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n\n        // Ensure index directory exists\n        fs::create_dir_all(&index_dir).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to create vector index directory: {}: {}\",\n                index_dir.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        let sessions_path = index_dir.join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE);\n        let sessions_map_path = index_dir.join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        let _chunks_path = index_dir.join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE); // Temporarily unused\n        let chunks_map_path = index_dir.join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n\n        // Load or create session index\n        let (sessions_index, sessions_id_map) = if sessions_path.exists() {\n            // Load existing index\n            let id_map = if sessions_map_path.exists() {\n                IdMap::load(&sessions_map_path)?\n            } else {\n                IdMap::default()\n            };\n            let index = Self::load_index_from_disk(&sessions_path, embedding_dim)?;\n            (Some(index), id_map)\n        } else {\n            // Create new index\n            let id_map = IdMap::default();\n            let index = Self::create_index(embedding_dim, config.bit_width)?;\n            (Some(index), id_map)\n        };\n\n        // Load or create chunk index\n        let (chunks_index, chunks_id_map) = if config.index_chunks {\n            if _chunks_path.exists() {\n                let id_map = if chunks_map_path.exists() {\n                    IdMap::load(&chunks_map_path)?\n                } else {\n                    IdMap::default()\n                };\n                let index = Self::load_index_from_disk(&_chunks_path, embedding_dim)?;\n                (Some(index), id_map)\n            } else {\n                let id_map = IdMap::default();\n                let index = Self::create_index(embedding_dim, config.bit_width)?;\n                (Some(index), id_map)\n            }\n        } else {\n            (None, IdMap::default())\n        };\n\n        Ok(VectorIndex {\n            sessions_index,\n            sessions_id_map,\n            chunks_index,\n            chunks_id_map,\n            data_dir,\n            config,\n            embedding_dim,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Create a new TurboQuantIndex with the given dimension and bit width\n    fn create_index(dim: usize, bit_width: u8) -> Result<TurboQuantIndex> {\n        // Validate bit width (turbovec supports 2, 3, or 4 bits)\n        if bit_width != 2 && bit_width != 3 && bit_width != 4 {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Invalid bit width: {}. Must be 2, 3, or 4\",\n                bit_width\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Validate dimension (must be multiple of 8)\n        if !dim.is_multiple_of(8) {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Invalid dimension: {}. Must be a multiple of 8\",\n                dim\n            )));\n        }\n\n        // Create the TurboQuantIndex with the specified parameters\n        TurboQuantIndex::new(dim, bit_width as usize).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to create TurboQuantIndex: {}\", e))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Load an index from disk\n    fn load_index_from_disk(path: &Path, _dim: usize) -> Result<TurboQuantIndex> {\n        TurboQuantIndex::load(path).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to load TurboQuantIndex from {}: {}\",\n                path.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Save indexes to disk\n    ///\n    /// Persists both the session and chunk indexes to their respective files.\n    /// This should be called after bulk updates (e.g., after embedding multiple sessions).\n    pub fn save(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let index_dir = self.data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\");\n\n        // Ensure index directory exists\n        fs::create_dir_all(&index_dir).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Failed to create vector index directory: {}: {}\",\n                index_dir.display(),\n                e\n            ))\n        })?;\n\n        // Save session index and ID map\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.sessions_index {\n            let sessions_path = index_dir.join(SESSIONS_INDEX_FILE);\n            index.write(&sessions_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to save session index: {}\", e))\n            })?;\n        }\n\n        let sessions_map_path = index_dir.join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        fs::create_dir_all(index_dir.join(\"sessions_\")).map_err(|e| {\n            AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to create sessions map directory: {}\", e))\n        })?;\n        self.sessions_id_map.save(&sessions_map_path)?;\n\n        // Save chunk index and ID map if chunks enabled\n        if self.config.index_chunks {\n            if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n                let chunks_path = index_dir.join(CHUNKS_INDEX_FILE);\n                index.write(&chunks_path).map_err(|e| {\n                    AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\"Failed to save chunk index: {}\", e))\n                })?;\n            }\n\n            let chunks_map_path = index_dir.join(\"chunks_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n            fs::create_dir_all(index_dir.join(\"chunks_\")).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to create chunks map directory: {}\",\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n            self.chunks_id_map.save(&chunks_map_path)?;\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Upsert a session-level embedding\n    ///\n    /// Inserts or updates the embedding for a session.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `id` - Session ID string (e.g., \"claude-code/83f5a4e7\")\n    /// * `embedding` - Embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    pub fn upsert_session(&mut self, id: &str, embedding: Vec<f32>) -> Result<()> {\n        if embedding.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                embedding.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref mut index) = self.sessions_index {\n            // Get the next index (or existing index if already inserted)\n            let vec_index = if let Some(idx_ref) = self.sessions_id_map.get(id) {\n                idx_ref\n            } else {\n                let idx = self.sessions_id_map.len();\n                self.sessions_id_map.insert(id.to_string(), idx);\n                idx\n            };\n\n            // Add or update the embedding\n            index.add(&embedding);\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Upsert a chunk-level embedding\n    ///\n    /// Inserts or updates the embedding for a conversation chunk.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `id` - Chunk ID string (e.g., \"claude-code/83f5a4e7#3\")\n    /// * `embedding` - Embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    pub fn upsert_chunk(&mut self, id: &str, embedding: Vec<f32>) -> Result<()> {\n        if !self.config.index_chunks {\n            return Ok(()); // Skip if chunk indexing is disabled\n        }\n\n        if embedding.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                embedding.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref mut index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Get the next index (or existing index if already inserted)\n            let vec_index = if let Some(&idx) = self.chunks_id_map.get(id) {\n                idx\n            } else {\n                let idx = self.chunks_id_map.len();\n                self.chunks_id_map.insert(id.to_string(), idx);\n                idx\n            };\n\n            // Add or update the embedding\n            index.add(&embedding);\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Search the session-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar sessions by cosine similarity.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `query_vec` - Query embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    /// * `k` - Number of results to return\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// A vector of (id_hash, similarity_score) tuples, sorted by similarity descending\n    pub fn search_sessions(&self, query_vec: &[f32], k: usize) -> Result<Vec<(String, f32)>> {\n        if query_vec.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.sessions_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // Convert indices back to IDs using the scores and indices fields\n            let converted: Vec<(String, f32)> = results\n                .indices\n                .iter()\n                .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.sessions_id_map.index_to_id.get(&(*idx as usize)).cloned().map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Search the chunk-level index\n    ///\n    /// Returns the top-K most similar chunks by cosine similarity.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `query_vec` - Query embedding vector (must match the configured embedding dimension)\n    /// * `k` - Number of results to return\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// A vector of (chunk_id, similarity_score) tuples, sorted by similarity descending\n    pub fn search_chunks(&self, query_vec: &[f32], k: usize) -> Result<Vec<(String, f32)>> {\n        if !self.config.index_chunks {\n            return Ok(Vec::new()); // Skip if chunk indexing is disabled\n        }\n\n        if query_vec.len() != self.embedding_dim {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                \"Query embedding dimension mismatch: expected {}, got {}\",\n                self.embedding_dim,\n                query_vec.len()\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if let Some(ref index) = self.chunks_index {\n            // Search the index - SearchResults doesn't implement map_err as it's not a Result\n            let results = index.search(query_vec, k);\n\n            // Convert indices back to IDs using the scores and indices fields\n            let converted: Vec<(String, f32)> = results\n                .indices\n                .iter()\n                .zip(results.scores.iter())\n                .filter_map(|(idx, score)| {\n                    if *idx < 0 {\n                        return None;\n                    }\n                    self.chunks_id_map.index_to_id.get(&(*idx as usize)).cloned().map(|id| (id, *score))\n                })\n                .collect();\n\n            Ok(converted)\n        } else {\n            Ok(Vec::new())\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of sessions in the index\n    pub fn session_count(&self) -> usize {\n        // Vector index temporarily disabled - return count from ID map\n        self.sessions_id_map.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Get the number of chunks in the index\n    pub fn chunk_count(&self) -> usize {\n        // Vector index temporarily disabled - return count from ID map\n        self.chunks_id_map.len()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if the index is empty\n    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {\n        self.session_count() == 0 && self.chunk_count() == 0\n    }\n\n    /// Get the embedding dimension\n    pub fn dimension(&self) -> usize {\n        self.embedding_dim\n    }\n\n    /// Get the bit width\n    pub fn self.data_dir.join(\"index\").join(\"vector\")\n    }\n\n    /// Get the sessions index file path\n    pub fn sessions_index_path(&self) -> PathBuf {\n }\n\n    /// Check if session index exists on disk\n    pub fn sessions_index_exists(&self) -> bool {\n        self.sessions_index_path().exists()\n    }\n\n    /// Check if chunk index exists on pub fn delete_sessions_index(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        let path = self.sessions_index_path();\n        if path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete session index: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        let map_path = self.index_dir().join(\"sessions_\").join(ID_MAP_FILE);\n        if map_path.exists() {\n            fs::remove_file(&map_path).map_err(|e| {\n                AgentScribeError::VectorIndex(format!(\n                    \"Failed to delete sessions ID map: {}: {}\",\n                    map_path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Delete the chunk index from disk\n    ///\n    /// This is useful for rebuilding the index from scratch.\n    pub fn delete_chunks_index(&self) ->              \"Failed to delete chunk index: {}: {}\",\n                    path.display(),\n                    e\n                ))\n            })?;\n        }\n        let map_path = self.delete_sessions_index()?;\n        self.delete_chunks_index()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build session text for embedding from events\n///\n/// Concatenates events with role prefixes to create a searchable text representation.\npub fn build_session_text(events: &[crate::event::Event]) -> String {\n    let mut text = String::new();\n\n    for event in events {\n        // Skip tool_result events for embedding (they're noisy)\n        if event.role == crate::event::Role::ToolResult {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        let prefix = match event.role {\n            crate::event::Role::User => \"user: \",\n            crate::event::Role::Assistant => \"assistant: \",\n            crate::event::Role::System => \"system: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolCall => \"tool: \",\n            crate::event::Role::ToolResult => continue, // already skipped above\n        };\n\n        text.push_str(prefix);\n        text.push_str(&event.content);\n        text.push('\\n');\n    }\n\n    text\n}\n\n/// Chunk session text into overlapping windows\n///\n/// Splits text into chunks of approximately `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n            end\n        };\n\n        chunks.push(text[start..chunk_end].trim().to_string());\n\n        // Move start with overlap\n        start = chunk_end.saturating_sub(overlap_chars);\n\n        // Prevent infinite loop\n        if start >= chunk_end {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use tempfile::TempDir;\n\n    fn `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = `chunk_size_tokens` tokens\n/// with `chunk_overlap_tokens` overlap between adjacent chunks.\npub fn chunk_session_text(\n    text: &str,\n    chunk_size_tokens: usize,\n    chunk_overlap_tokens: usize,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    if text.is_empty() {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    // Estimate character count from tokens (roughly 4 chars per token)\n    let chunk_size_chars = chunk_size_tokens * 4;\n    let overlap_chars = chunk_overlap_tokens * 4;\n\n    if text.len() <= chunk_size_chars {\n        return vec![text.to_string()];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0;\n\n    while start < text.len() {\n        let end = (start + chunk_size_chars).min(text.len());\n\n        // Find a word boundary near the end\n        let chunk_end = if end < text.len() {\n            text[end..]\n                .find(' ')\n                .map(|offset| end + offset)\n                .unwrap_or(end)\n        } else {\n
